source_claim: Avatar Studios' official timeline places Avatar Kyoshi and Suki in entries explicitly titled Avatar: The Last Airbender and places Mako in a Legend of Korra entry. Nickelodeon's official character profiles identify Mai and Momo and give their first appearances in Avatar: The Last Airbender episodes. These sources support title-specific HOME relations for five exact members; the sixth member Jin was not safely established by the checked first-party sources.
notes: Avatar Studios' official timeline (https://www.avatarstudiosofficial.com/timeline/) labels Avatar Day and Escape from the Spirit World as Avatar: The Last Airbender and explicitly describes Kyoshi in both; it labels Suki, Alone as Avatar: The Last Airbender and describes Suki, and labels Republic City Hustle as The Legend of Korra while naming Mako. Nickelodeon's official Mai profile (https://www.nick.com/info-page/esmqi5/mai) and Momo profile (https://www.nick.com/info-page/exlf40/momo) identify their first appearances in Avatar: The Last Airbender episodes. Relations are title-specific, not a shared Avatar franchise umbrella. Jin is omitted: search for an official animation-era source did not identify the exact `jin_(avatar)` member; the surfaced official live-action adaptation material is not evidence for the source Character tag. No negative or terminal conclusion is asserted for Jin.
